description: Plan v7 section 8.3 same-language-flattening clause, boundary half: pt-PT is loaded but does NOT carry the key, so per-key fallback reaches the pt catalog. DefaultStrings.getResult passes `candidateLocale` -- the locale that SUPPLIED the entry -- into getInternal (DefaultStrings.java:712), and cardinalityForValue classifies with that locale (DefaultStrings.java:1438), so the pt entry's cardinality placeholder is evaluated under pt's rules even though the caller asked for pt-PT. This fixture exists so that 'never flatten pt-PT into pt' cannot be over-applied into 'a pt entry served to a pt-PT caller must use pt-PT rules'. The pt-PT file carries an unrelated key rather than being absent or empty: pt-PT must remain a LOADED locale, otherwise the mandatory pt tiebreaker list would no longer be an exact permutation of the loaded pt-language locales and the fixture would not build.
